study: spec 029: the carried prior where the ownship holds course (not a gate)
registered: 2026-11-19, before seeds 363 and 364 exist (generated only in their CI runs)
data: realistic engagements (configs/long/realistic.json realism) with ownship legs 3600-7200 s; 6 and 12 hours; contact 1 only; 1-hour windows overlapping 15 min
classes: held = no ownship turn overlaps the window's rows; one = exactly one; more = two or more (empty on tuning); each chain's first window and every window with no hand-over excluded
estimand: geometric mean over windows of ctl ÷ ctl-prior, per-window median range error; 95% interval from 2,000 bootstrap resamples over engagements (seed 29)

rule.gain: lower limit on held windows above 1 (range)
rule.harm: upper limit below 1 on held, one or more (where non-empty), in range, course or speed

soundness_on_validation.S1: at least 95% of planned windows ran and no engagement missing
soundness_on_validation.S2: per-engagement geometric mean of ctl ÷ the true-history fit in [0.8, 4]
soundness_on_validation.S3: coverage of the carried 95% region on hand-overs into held windows in [0.80, 0.99]
soundness_on_validation.on_failure: the study stops before the test
